description: List jobs across Ashby job boards, fetch specific job postings by URL or ID, or summarize a company's board.

department.description: Case-insensitive text match over department and team. Examples: `Engineering`, `Sales`, `Design`.
department.title: Department or team (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

hasSalaryOnly.description: Drop jobs where the employer did not publish a salary range.
hasSalaryOnly.title: Only jobs with a published salary (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

includeCompanyInfo.description: Fetch each company's public board page once for its display name, logo, and timezone. Adds one request per company. Off in the daily test prefill.
includeCompanyInfo.title: Include company name and logo

includeDescriptionHtml.description: Add the original `descriptionHtml` to each job. Increases dataset size.
includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include HTML description (mode=byOrg, jobDetail)

includeDescriptionPlain.description: Add `descriptionPlain` to each job. On by default; turn it off for compact metadata-only rows.
includeDescriptionPlain.title: Include plain-text description (mode=byOrg, jobDetail)

includeDetails.description: Fetch each returned job's public page for all team names, confidentiality, compensation philosophy, direct-apply flag, and remote-eligible countries. Adds one request per job; slower on large runs.
includeDetails.title: Include job-page details (mode=byOrg, jobDetail)

includeUnlisted.description: Include jobs marked `isListed:false` (direct-link-only postings that are not shown on the public board). Applies to every mode: `jobDetail` returns a `job_not_listed` error for an unlisted job unless this is on. Off by default.
includeUnlisted.title: Include unlisted jobs

isRemoteOnly.description: Keep jobs the board marks as remote. Ashby sets this for both Remote and Hybrid roles; use `workplaceType=Remote` for fully remote jobs.
isRemoteOnly.title: Remote-friendly only (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

jobId.description: The Ashby posting UUID or a full job URL. Used alone or with `orgSlug`.
jobId.title: Job ID (mode=jobDetail)

jobUrls.description: Public Ashby job posting URLs, e.g. `https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Ramp/<job-id>`. The `/application` suffix and query strings are accepted.
jobUrls.title: Job URLs (mode=jobDetail)

location.description: Case-insensitive text match over the primary location, secondary locations, city, region, and country. Examples: `New York`, `Remote`, `London`.
location.title: Location (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

maxAnnualSalary.description: Keep jobs whose published annual salary range overlaps this maximum. Use with `minAnnualSalary` for a range.
maxAnnualSalary.title: Maximum annual salary (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of job records (or company summaries) pushed to the dataset. Error records for invalid inputs are additional diagnostics and do not count.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxItemsPerOrg.description: Cap the number of job records from each company after filters. `0` means no per-company cap.
maxItemsPerOrg.title: Max jobs per company (mode=byOrg)

minAnnualSalary.description: Keep jobs whose published annual salary range overlaps this minimum. Hourly, monthly, and weekly ranges are annualized. Jobs with no published salary are kept unless `hasSalaryOnly` is on.
minAnnualSalary.title: Minimum annual salary (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

mode.description: What to collect. `byOrg` lists jobs from one or more companies; `jobDetail` fetches specific postings by URL or ID; `boardSummary` returns one departments/locations/compensation summary per company. The legacy values are kept so saved tasks continue to run.
enumTitles: Fetch specific jobs by URL or ID
mode.title: Mode

orgSlug.description: Used with `jobId` when you do not have a full job URL. Example: `Ramp`.
orgSlug.title: Company slug (mode=jobDetail)

orgSlugs.description: Ashby board slugs, company names, or board URLs. Examples: `Ramp`, `Neko Health`, `https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Ramp`. Names are matched to the closest live board automatically.
orgSlugs.title: Companies (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

publishedAfter.description: Only jobs published on or after this date. Accepts `YYYY-MM-DD`, an ISO datetime, or a relative window such as `24h`, `7d`, or `2w`.
publishedAfter.title: Published after (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

publishedBefore.description: Only jobs published on or before this date. Accepts `YYYY-MM-DD`, an ISO datetime, or a relative window.
publishedBefore.title: Published before (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

salaryCurrency.description: Only compare salaries in this currency. `any` compares the numeric range as published (currencies are not converted).
salaryCurrency.title: Salary currency (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

searchQuery.description: Case-insensitive text match over title, department, team, location, and description. Descriptions are searched even when `includeDescriptionPlain` is off and in `boardSummary` mode. Examples: `engineer`, `payments`, `München`.
searchQuery.title: Search text (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

sortBy.description: Order of the returned job records. `default` keeps the board's own order.
sortBy.title: Sort results (mode=byOrg)

workplaceType.description: Keep only fully remote, hybrid, or on-site jobs. Unlike `isRemoteOnly`, this separates Remote from Hybrid. Jobs with no workplace type are excluded when a specific value is chosen.
workplaceType.title: Workplace type (mode=byOrg, boardSummary)

title: Ashby Job Board Scraper Input
